correctness.rationale: Positivity of every loss rate forces any real-eigenvalue vector of K into the common detector kernel. The direct sum of these H-eigenspaces reduces H and K, and the complement decays, even for defective K, so eventual capture is the bright-projector diagonal. The shell vectors x_i−s/d span a permutation-invariant standard sector of dimension d−1 in each interior shell; comparing adjacent-shell coefficients yields the stated recurrence and cyclic generation from shell 1. The radial H-eigenvectors are the symmetrized Walsh modes with distinct energies since J>0. Their detector overlap is proportional to d−2k, so only the middle radial mode at even d is missing. Radial and standard diagonals are constant per shell with traces 1 and d−1 respectively, and subtracting that single mode gives the formula, including d=2 and both endpoint shells. An independent exact Gram-projector replay (/workspace/branches/replay3.py) passed all shell probabilities, ranks and traces for d=2 through 14; it is finite corroboration only, not the all-d proof. The supplied numerical verifier was read, not executed.
